Bidirectionality inside a single function is strong confirmation of the law's allocator-not-source claim. claim.law.parameter-save-area-width-sets-the-local-block-floor.20260901.v1 SCREENED AND NOT APPLICABLE: slotdiff reports frame target 184 / ours 184, saves r16 both, SLOT MAP IDENTICAL (5 slots each) - no uniform displacement, so no parameter-width bug; the function takes a single s32 mode with no FP parameter. claim.law.mwcc-ctr-loop-strength-reduction-is-defeated-by-an-in-body-exit-test.20260831.v1 NOT APPLICABLE: no mtctr/bdnz-vs-cmpw/bge signature; the loops already agree. claim.law.ternary-diamond-reaches-forward-branch-pair-at-cost-of-temp-result-register.20260831.v1 NOT APPLICABLE: no branch-opcode rows differ. claim.law.r0-homed-address-temp-forces-the-indexed-store-form.20260901.v1 NOT APPLICABLE: no store-form difference. claim.law.local-block-is-bottom-anchored-so-the-lowest-pad-is-the-shift-lever.20260831.v1 and claim.law.switch-arm-inner-blocks-overlay...20260831.v1 NOT APPLICABLE: slot map already identical, no pad to dial; note the v1 record's committed 96/88-byte frame-pad history is consistent with the frame now being exact. claim.law.narrow-type-buys-rlwimi-insert-and-pays-a-masked-shift.20260901.v1 NOT APPLICABLE: no rlwimi/rlwinm rows.
attributes.residual: BASELINE CORRECTION: the v1 record states baseline real 516; the measured baseline at this commit is real 504 (433/433, multiset 8t, frame 0xB8, SLOT MAP IDENTICAL). Use 504. MECHANISM, re-derived from the target rather than from v1's label. v1 classified the residual STRUCTURAL/CSE_REGISTER_WEB and prescribed 'a new cross-mode lifetime reconstruction'. The target asm refutes that framing. At 0x588 the target loads li r19,4882 ONCE and reuses r19 at 0x598 (site-1 condition), 0x5c0 (site-1 argument) and 0x608 (site-2 argument), yet REMATERIALIZES the same constant into r0 at 0x5e4 for the site-2 condition. Decisively, site 1's condition (divwu. r0,r22,r19) and argument (divwu r4,r22,r19) have IDENTICAL operands and are still not CSE'd across the intervening MBNewTempQuad/mbBlitCalcWidth calls, while our build keeps the quotient alive in a nonvolatile and copies it. So the divwu gap is the allocator's recompute-vs-keep-alive-across-a-call choice on an identical expression - the same family as the live-zero law, not a cross-mode lifetime problem - and the target's own inconsistency on one constant (r19 reused three times but rematerialized to r0 once) means no single source spelling can reproduce both behaviours. PROBE RESULT, which pins the price precisely: introducing u32 scale = 4882 and using it at exactly the three target-r19 sites DID restore the divwu (that cluster disappears from --ops entirely) but cost one extra li, giving 434/433 insns, multiset 9t and real 504 -> 541. This independently reproduces v1's axis-4 outcome (434, real 553) with a cleaner, target-backed form and a better score, and completes the 3-probe cap on the divisor axis. Reverted via probe.py --revert.
